deliverables: Custodial wallet onboarding inside Sellout's flow
Public launch campaign and trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and quarterly reporting
request.recipient: Intersect as budget administrator, with funds disbursed through the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework for the Anvil/Sellout project.
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency.

claims.claim: Phase 1 of the ticketing platform, including on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification, is already live on Cardano mainnet and was funded by Sellout with over $130,000 invested.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, over 8 months including a 3% Intersect administration fee.
Phase 2 will deliver a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent audit, and launch amplification.
Sellout has more than 200,000 registered users, has issued more than 250,000 tickets to date, and runs more than 350 events annually at its current cadence.
The project targets 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6,000,000+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets within 12 months from launch.
The team commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism using 25% of fees until full reimbursement and 5% thereafter.
Milestone-gated disbursement, unused contingency return, independent audit, oversight review, quarterly reporting, and contractual revenue-share repayment are presented as treasury protections.
The proposal says all on-chain metrics will be independently verifiable through Cardano explorer data, policy-ID tracking, a public dashboard in M5, and quarterly Cardano Forum reports.
The requested amount is asserted not to breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.
Anvil/Sellout state they have not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document describes a 4,969,231 ada treasury withdrawal for an 8-month Phase 2 build of a Cardano-native ticketing marketplace, with milestone gating, Intersect/TRSC/PSSC administration, proposed treasury repayment through revenue share, and adoption targets tied to Sellout's existing user base and ticketing operations.
